The trailing -1 is a Wix artefact and is kept verbatim because that is the indexed form. 301 rather than 404: this was a functioning service page, not template junk like the store URLs, so its equity follows to the service index. That is a topical relationship, not the soft-404 pattern url-decisions.md warns about.
